test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people A, H, D, F, T, E, and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit to the left of E. G and H are immediate neighbours of E. A sits at the extreme right of the row. D is the immediate neighbour of A. F sits second to the left of E. Who sits at the extreme left of the row?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Given: **Seven people A, H, D, F, T, E, and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) Only three people sit to the left of E.

(It means E sits on the middle of the row) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/778e122a394e1bb7a24bdea116455e80007c7bd1a66d3db4e9a637939e336396.png] 

2) A sits at the extreme right of the row. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e09ca483f298f543dddc10b94335d9a5d232662492326e0ee6fb8c6193dae98.png] 

3) F sits second to the left of E. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/439312169692bfd064c5c2389470317f8247f99defd5074e1745b15f0a4c7b94.png] 

4) G and H are immediate neighbours of E.

(Position of G and H is not clear but they sit either side of E) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb92dafa7cb1b894adfc4bdc44b36efa4b9d5ace42b51800b8821a2dcf1d6ad2.png] 

5) D is the immediate neighbour of A. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0cc80ef89deee12d67482788edf709ac320c72f142f3d315984045f95423a0d.png] 

6) So, T sits on the vacant place. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6812f880070625931d74868482d656cb24e87844332ddb8565b7ef26d8cb662.png] 

Clearly, T sits extreme left of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"T".**
